summary: The glossary holds two Approved entries for 'Trade Date' that conflict: GL-301 (owner Casey Example, v1.3) defines it as the date a trade is executed, booked on the same business day (T+0); GL-302 (owner Devon Example, v1.1) defines it as the date a trade is executed, booked on the following business day (T+1). They agree that Trade Date is the execution date but are incompatible on booking timing. A term link marks them as possible_duplicate. Neither is picked here; a single definition cannot be given until a human Data Steward resolves the conflict. No CDE designation is made: both entries record recorded_cde_flag=false, and no CDE-criteria policy document has been identified.
